description: This Java interface defines a generic contract for distributed data handling, including methods for obtaining data readers and writers, and creating subscriptions, as part of a pub-sub framework in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns the distributed data reader for type R.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the distributed data writer for type W.

methods.name: createSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty Subscriptions object for type W.
